declarations.description: Responsive anchored desktop popover, centered tablet panel, and mobile bottom sheet with optional touch dismissal at viewport widths up to 40rem.
declarations.name: JBPopoverWebComponent

attributes.name: is-open
attributes.description: Opens the popover when set to true. Any other value closes it.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Element id. On mobile, an id enables URL hash state while the popover is open.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible label applied to the internal dialog when modal behavior is active.

members.name: isOpen
members.description: True until dismissal animation finishes; closed reports completion.

members.name: positionArea
members.description: Preferred anchor alignment used after bindTarget().

members.name: overflowHandler
members.description: Overflow handling mode. SLIDE moves the content upward when it overflows.

members.name: overflowDom
members.description: Element used as the overflow boundary. Defaults to the window height.

members.name: PopoverHashPath
members.description: Hash path generated from id, such as #actions-popover.

members.name: JBID
members.description: Internal unique symbol for this popover instance.

members.name: swipeToClose
members.description: Enable downward touch dismissal from the backdrop or mobile bottom-sheet handle and, when opted in, content. Applies only at widths up to 40rem. Set as a JavaScript property, not an HTML attribute.

members.name: dragFromContent
members.description: Opt in to downward gestures starting in content. Scrollable ancestors must already be at the top when touch starts; scrolling to the top requires a new gesture. Interactive controls, horizontal gestures, and regions marked data-jb-popover-no-drag are excluded. Requires swipeToClose.

members.name: autoPlacement
members.description: Flip and shift desktop placement inside the viewport; false requests exact alignment.

members.name: modal
members.description: Auto enables modal focus containment, inert background, and scroll locking on mobile/tablet. Set false for non-modal pickers or true for modal desktop popovers.

members.name: closeOnEscape
members.description: Allow Escape to request dismissal of the topmost popover.

members.name: restoreFocus
members.description: Opt in to restoring the previously focused element on close. Leave disabled for triggers that open on focus.

members.name: autoCloseOnBackgroundClick
members.description: Automatically close after an allowed backdrop click request.

members.name: isMobileMode
members.description: True at widths up to 48rem, including tablets.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the popover, updates anchor position, and pushes mobile hash history when id is set.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Animate dismissal, release focus/scroll/history ownership, and emit closed on completion. Programmatic calls bypass close-request events.

methods.name: bindTarget
methods.description: Bind or replace the desktop anchor, restarting size and scroll observation when open.

methods.name: unBindTarget
methods.description: Removes the bound anchor and resets positioning.

methods.name: checkInitialOpenness
methods.description: Opens the popover when the current URL hash matches its id.

events.name: load
events.description: Dispatched from connectedCallback before event listeners are registered.

events.name: url-open
events.description: Dispatched when the popover opens itself because the current URL hash matches its id.

events.name: close
events.description: Cancelable bubbling/composed swipe, backdrop, or Escape request after cancel. HISTORY_BACK_EVENT is a notification; use closed for animation completion.

events.name: cancel
events.description: Cancelable bubbling/composed request for SWIPE_DOWN, BACKGROUND_CLICK, or ESCAPE_KEY. preventDefault keeps the popover open.

events.name: closed
events.description: Bubbling/composed completion event after any close animation. isOpen is now false; focus and scroll state have been restored.

cssParts.name: backdrop
cssParts.description: Mobile and tablet overlay backdrop. Owns background color, blur, and opacity; supports backdrop clicks and mobile swipe gestures.

cssProperties.name: --jb-popover-bg-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the content wrapper.

cssProperties.name: --jb-popover-border-radius
cssProperties.description: Border radius of the content wrapper.

cssProperties.name: --jb-popover-top
cssProperties.description: Top position in desktop mode when not bound to an anchor.

cssProperties.name: --jb-popover-box-shadow
cssProperties.description: Box shadow of the popover content wrapper.
